backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, story submission, commenting, moderation, and access control with admin/user permissions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router with routes for feed, submit, story details, admin, and about pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access denied message with a button to return to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar with site title and buttons for navigating to stories and story submission.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with about link.
Form component for submitting comments using mutation hooks with validation and error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a story's comments or fallback messaging, with loading skeletons and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on user identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: React Query hooks for fetching pending stories and publishing them through admin APIs.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Defines React Query hooks to fetch stories, submit new stories, and add comments through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind setup and defines light/dark theme CSS variables with typography and UI styling rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a static About page describing the author and the platform’s purpose.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Implements an admin interface to review, edit, and publish submitted stories with authorization handling.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays a hero section and a feed of published stories with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed view of a single published story with comments, including loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: React page providing a story submission form with optional anonymity and showing a success state after mutation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, typography, layout extensions, animations, and enabled plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, design direction, known issues, and versioned state for the storytelling platform.
